name: Jellyfin Compressor (EXPERIMENTAL)
overview: EXPERIMENTAL: compress movies while keeping recoverable originals.
description: Experimental Jellyfin 10.11.6 movie compressor. Automatic compression is disabled by default. Test with disposable media before use on a real library.

versions.changelog: Experimental preview: queue one movie, select a maximum resolution without upscaling, browse originals folders and adjust file stability. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: redesigned dashboard, visual folder browser and grouped settings. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: configurable original-folder size limit, age-based retention and verified cleanup after restoration.
